Remediations.Description: Get Xbox Game Pass Premium today to take advantage of a catalog of hundreds of high-quality games, online console multiplayer, and exclusive deals.
With Game Pass, you can play more great games anytime.

Affirmations.Description: with your Xbox Game Pass Premium membership.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Join millions of players worldwide in the most played Solitaire game in history - including even MORE great games to play!

Enjoy classic Solitaire game modes everyone loves - Klondike Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, TriPeaks Solitaire & Pyramid Solitaire. Keep your mind sharp increasing your Difficulty, completing Daily Challenges, playing Weekly Rewards, or climbing the leaderboard in Events. Celebrate WINS by leveling up with XP, collecting Trophies, Achievements & MORE! 

Plus, discover other great match-3, arcade & puzzle games ready to play inside Microsoft Solitaire Collection - Microsoft Bubble, Microsoft Jewel 2, Gravity Blocks, Gem Drop, Mahjong 3D and other favorites.

Sign in with a Microsoft or Xbox Account to save your progress, collect awards and play across devices.
With so much to play, Microsoft Solitaire Collection is the perfect app for everyone.

Become a Premium Member (included with Game Pass)
• Play Ad-FREE
• Collect XP (win or lose)
• Daily Challenges: 2x points & access to past Challenges
• Unlimited use of Solitaire Solver
• Special boosts in Endless TriPeaks & Pyramid 
• Extra bonuses in other games 
• FREE Retro bundle & Xbox card backs

Celebrate over 35 years of the best Solitaire & Casual Games in one great app - Microsoft Solitaire Collection!
